prompt: write a 4 page report on philosophy of mathematics  based on this article https://philosophynow.org/issues/19/What_is_the_Philosophy_of_Mathematics
judge_reasoning: The prompt asks for a (roughly) 4-page report on the philosophy of mathematics based on the specified Philosophy Now article. Candidate 2 is the most on-topic and gives the broad set of mainstream positions (Platonism, formalism, intuitionism, etc.) in a clear structure, but it still contains several significant factual/historical hallucinations (e.g., claims about Gauss, quantum mechanics, and Gödel). Candidate 1 is closer thematically but is evidently incomplete/truncated and therefore fails the “report length/completeness” aspect more than the others. Candidates 3 and 4 introduce multiple major incorrect claims about what the article says and include serious errors (e.g., Gödel’s “completeness of arithmetic”), making them less reliable overall.
